topPRs.title: Update release docs: op-contracts v9.0.0-rc.1
topPRs.author: mintlify
topPRs.body:
## Summary
Adds the op-contracts v9.0.0-rc.1 release candidate (published October 30, 2026) to the op-contracts release page.

## Changes
- Prepended a `v9.0.0-rc.1` `<Update>` entry tagged `Release Candidate` to `releases/op-contracts.mdx`.
- `releases/index.mdx` is unchanged because the release is a prerelease, so the newest stable op-contracts version is still v7.0.0.

## Context
This is the only tracked release published in the review window. Other recent releases are already covered by open PRs #23802, #23774, #23735, #23691 and #23635.

topPRs.title: op-acceptance-tests,safedb: validate parity after Kona resync
topPRs.author: einar-oplabs
topPRs.body:
SafeDB parity coverage compared Kona with op-node after restarts that retained EL data, leaving the existing CL-resync requirement unverified. This exercises recovery with a fresh in-memory op-geth EL while retaining Kona's SafeDB, then checks historical answers in both directions and compares super-root data. The existing parity scenarios retain op-reth.

Related to https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/23585 and https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/23473. This does not establish canonical-tip EL-sync recovery or interval-based gap detection. The deliberate wrong-key negative control has passed its red/green acceptance checks in isolated CI job 5812896; no intentional production mutation is included.

Package compilation, full repository Go lint (zero issues), module tidiness, formatting, and Go/SafeDB reviews pass for the test changes. The new resync case passes twice in isolated native CI; the wrong-key control produces the required mismatch and positive tests pass after exact source restoration. Full normal PR CI is complete: 52 checks passed and 3 skipped, with zero failures or pending checks. No findings were dismissed.

- [x] Compile the parity package, pass full repository Go lint/module tidiness, and complete Go/SafeDB review without findings.
- [x] Sign the commit and request Josh/Akos; assigned to Einar, Protocol Sprint 20, In Progress.
- [x] The new mixed-node resync case passes before and after the negative control in native CI job 5812896, with the restarted EL verified at genesis and both RPC histories compared after catch-up.
- [x] The wrong-key control fails with the expected parity-mismatch diagnostic, and both positive tests pass after byte-for-byte restoration; expected failure reports stay out of normal test insights.
- [x] Normal PR CI is complete: 52 checks passed, 3 skipped, zero failures or pending checks. All six parity cases pass on this commit in native CI job 5812786.
- [ ] Human approval and merge.

Runtime evidence: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/23818#issuecomment-6537168761

topPRs.title: docs/public-docs: fix op-reth stage unwind flag order and include --chain
topPRs.author: gttps
topPRs.body:
Fixes #23174

Places --datadir=<path> and --chain=<chain> before the 	o-block <BLOCK_NUMBER> subcommand in 
ode-operators/guides/troubleshooting.mdx to match the op-reth stage unwind CLI definition, and clarifies that --chain should be specified explicitly since it defaults to optimism (OP Mainnet).

topPRs.title: docs/public-docs: point eth_sendRawTransaction troubleshooting at execution client
topPRs.author: gttps
topPRs.body:
Fixes #23176

Updates step 2 of the eth_sendRawTransaction Does Not Exist troubleshooting section in docs/public-docs/node-operators/guides/troubleshooting.mdx to point specifically at the execution client (op-reth) rather than op-node, op-batcher, and op-proposer (since only the execution client forwards eth_sendRawTransaction and defines --rollup.sequencer), and clarifies checking the service's own runtime environment (Environment= / EnvironmentFile= in systemd unit files or container environment variables).
